services.desc: Available for lease at Goldspirit Farm. Graesan is a lovely Hannovarian mare that excels in dressage. She shas shown through second level dressage. She is available for a partial lease. Available for lease at Goldspirit Farm. Pearl is a precious jewel and boy does she know it! She is everyone's favorite ride! She is a true eventer and excels in dressage, stadium jumping, and cross country. She and the other horses of Goldspirit Farm are all available for lease on site! Miconi Warrior is a registerd paint gelding. He is 13 years old and nearly 17 hands. This guy is the bomb! quiet! nice gaits! easy to ride! Jumps, knows his lead changes, is learning dressage, great on trail. Offered for sale

blurb: Located in Southern California, less than thirty minutes from downtown Los Angeles, and minutes from the San Fernando and Santa Clarita Valleys, Goldspirit Farm is a training and boarding facility for eventing, dressage and jumpers. Riders of all levels with an interest in eventing, dressage, jumpers, or English basics are welcome. Check out this amazing video of Goldspirit Farm. OVERVIEW OF GOLDSPIRIT
